name: Metamagic Rod, Occult Infusion
body:
Aura moderate occult; CL 17th; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 12,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that automatically succeed at all concentration checks that he makes to avoid losing the spell as though using the Occult Infusion feat. If you are not bound to a spirit when attempting to activate this rod, you must succeed at a DC 20 Use Magic Device to emulate the bind spirit class feature.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Occult Infusion; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 6,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater).
